facts: Land area of 3,521 km², scattered over more than 2,000 km of ocean
Highest point: Mount Orohena on Tahiti
worth_knowing: Tahiti, in the Society Islands, is the largest and most populated island. Bora Bora, Mo'orea and Nuku Hiva are among the other important islands.
